content.text:
The New Year push finished at 00:00 UTC on 13 January with 415.91 USD spent, which is under the 450.00 USD budget. I couldn't measure installs, because X has no pixel on your site.

| | Spend (USD) | Impressions | Link clicks |
|---|---|---|---|
| Post 2138062508651453803 ("New year, new pots") | 206.89 | 207,453 | 101 |
| Post 2138243702585486562 ("resolution wobbled") | 209.02 | 185,491 | 84 |
| **Total** | **415.91** | **392,944** | **185** |

- **Setup:** I ran one campaign with two ad groups, one per approved post. Both targeted the UK only, aged 18 and over, with a 20 USD daily budget and a 220 USD cap each, and both ran from 2 to 13 January. I didn't write any new posts.
- **Age targeting:** X's age options didn't allow separate adult bands such as 25–34. I used "18 and over", which matches the landing page's 18+ rule.
- **Performance:** I checked on 5 and 9 January. The "New year, new pots" post got more link clicks (about 0.049% of impressions, against 0.045% for the other) at slightly lower spend. The gap was small, so I left both running and made no changes.
- **Installs:** To see how many installs this drove, compare the 185 link clicks with install numbers from your side, such as app store or landing-page analytics.

Everything has ended, so nothing is still spending.
